mapper.sql: SELECT c.COURSE_ID, c.COURSE_NAME, c.DESCRIPTION, c.INSTRUCTOR_ID, u.USER_NAME AS INSTRUCTOR_NAME, c.MAJOR, c.RECRUIT_START_DATE, c.RECRUIT_END_DATE, c.START_DATE, c.END_DATE, c.CAPACITY, c.ENROLLED_CNT, c.STATUS_CD, s.CODE_NAME AS STATUS_NAME FROM TB_COURSE c JOIN TB_USER u ON u.USER_ID = c.INSTRUCTOR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_COMMON_CODE s ON s.GROUP_CD = 'COURSE_STATUS' AND s.CODE = c.STATUS_CD WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COURSE (COURSE_NAME, DESCRIPTION, INSTRUCTOR_ID, MAJOR, RECRUIT_START_DATE, RECRUIT_END_DATE, START_DATE, END_DATE, CAPACITY, STATUS_CD) VALUES (#{courseName}, #{description}, #{instructorId}, #{major}, #{recruitStartDate}, #{recruitEndDate}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{capacity}, #{statusCd})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COURSE SET COURSE_NAME = #{courseName}, DESCRIPTION = #{description}, MAJOR = #{major}, RECRUIT_START_DATE = #{recruitStartDate}, RECRUIT_END_DATE = #{recruitEndDate}, START_DATE = #{startDate}, END_DATE = #{endDate}, CAPACITY = #{capacity}, STATUS_CD = #{statusCd} WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN END_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '40' WHEN START_DATE <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '30' WHEN RECRUIT_START_DATE > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '15' WHEN RECRUIT_END_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '20' ELSE '25' END
